from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data_dict, data_keys):
    key1, key2 = data_keys[0], data_keys[1]
    x = data_dict[key1]
    y = data_dict[key2]

    if len(x) != len(y):
        raise ValueError("Data series must have the same length.")
    if len(x) < 2:
        raise ValueError("At least 2 data points are required to compute correlation.")

    corr, _ = stats.pearsonr(x, y)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.scatter(x, y)
    ax.set_xlabel(str(key1))
    ax.set_ylabel(str(key2))
    ax.set_title(f"Scatter plot of {key1} vs {key2}")

    return float(corr), ax
